endorsements.quote: Nursing curricula must prepare students to engage with GenAI critically and ethically while recognizing both its risks and potential learning value.
Adoption may be strengthened through faculty workshops, peer review of AI-enhanced teaching materials, and integration into simulation labs or professional development portfolios.

unlisted_practices: Embed ethical reasoning about bias, equity, and accountability into nursing education using case vignettes, reflection prompts, and faculty assessment rubrics on GenAI-supported clinical prioritization.
Update educational case vignettes periodically as generative AI systems evolve.
Evaluate the nursing GenAI ethics toolkit in authentic educational settings for its impact on ethical reasoning, bias recognition, and accountability.
Accreditation bodies and professional organizations should consider embedding AI ethics into educational standards.

screen.reason: The paper describes the conceptual development of an educational AI ethics toolkit and framework for nursing education rather than presenting empirical evaluation data or testing deployment practices.
